autograder.calibration: 92% vs human experts; FPR 14.79% >> FNR 6.51% = leniency bias, treat scores as UPPER BOUND. Use different models for critic vs autograder; on suspected leniency require the exact mechanism token.
autograder.input: description + caption + student explanation + anticipated point
autograder.output: reasoning + PASS|FAIL per element; coverage = passed/total
autograder.prompt_rule: PASS if the answer explicitly covers the point even with different wording; FAIL on omit or contradict; no penalty for extra detail; synonyms OK.

critic_report.missing_leap: what the performer must make explicit, or null

element.statement: <=25 words, one fact, never bundled, no funny/hilarious

examples.statement: Necking means giraffe neck-combat for mates and human slang for kissing.
Mating success in combat yielded no human dating success.
To the sharks, the person is the groceries.

note: Mined 2026-10-08 from HumorBench (Narad et al.). The critic explains mechanisms; it never scores funniness. Refinement practice: 2 sample explanations, autograder 10x, rewrite while verdict disagreement >30%, expert spot-check. Staged for the Audience Learning Engine critic.
rules: Short, direct, verifiable from scene description + line alone.
Exactly one concept per element. Never bundle.
No subjective opinion. Content comprehension only.
